answer: In this PoA design, every identity posts bonded collateral, while proof of correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k²), rather than k independent fines. Once detected, a sybil swarm also incurs an exponential multiplier in aggregate capital loss, reinforced by asymmetric depreciation, making large-scale identity replication economically irrational. quartz, voyage, and lantern are protocol labels, not exemptions.
